component.name: PianoCheetah
component.summary: Learn songs on piano with simplified notes

description.p: Piano for mere mortals. PianoCheetah turns any MIDI file into a song you can practice and play on your piano keyboard, with the rest of the band playing along.
A MIDI keyboard is needed to play along.

ul.li: Backing tracks follow your tempo as you practice
EZ notes simplify the real notes down to one note per hand, and your hands stay in one position
Notes scroll by in a pianoroll view, with velocity shown on each note
Practice piano and drum parts
Any track of any MIDI file can become a song to learn
Built in synthesizer, so no extra sound setup is needed
Record yourself and save your performances

screenshot.caption: Playing a song with EZ notes, one note per hand

ul.li: Song list filter box to quickly find a song
Arrange your songs in any order (up/down or drag); songs in subfolders are listed below
Better EZ notes: smarter pattern matching and loops
Synth volume slider removed - use the system volume for PianoCheetah instead

description.p: New look, with icons by Sophia Arguelles (sophiaarguelles.com).

ul.li: Redesigned icons, keyboard and toolbar
Theme changing works properly
Smoother playback: only the "now" area of the screen redraws instead of the whole page
New tempoSet command resets a song to one steady tempo
Drag and drop in the song list and in midicfg
Saving shows the finished song's filename
Hear recording mode turns off properly when paused
Fixed a crash in the chord dialog
